_source: aws wafv2 describe-managed-rule-group --vendor-name AWS --name AWSManagedRulesKnownBadInputsRuleSet --scope CLOUDFRONT --region us-east-1 --query 'Rules[].Name'
_why: AWS silently ignores a ruleActionOverride that names a rule the group does not ship, so the override list has to be checked against the group's real rules rather than against a hand-written copy of itself.
